name: dumbbell hang snatch
description: A powerful one-arm lift where the dumbbell goes from hip height to overhead in one motion.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead and catch it with a straight arm.
Stand tall, then lower back to the hang.
Switch arms and keep the weight light enough to move fast.
